component.name: OmniSim
component.summary: Robotics simulator for debugging robot software

description.p: OmniSim is a robotics simulator built as an instrument for finding out what a robot actually did. Run a controller, then ask what happened: every contact, every joint limit, every grip and every line the controller printed arrive on one cursor-paged HTTP stream, next to typed load diagnostics and scene, joint and device inspection. When an instrument cannot see, it says so and gives a reason, instead of returning an empty answer that reads like a clean result.

AI coding agents are first-class users: an HTTP/JSON harness, a first-party MCP server, a ROS 2 sidecar, and an AGENTS.md entry point at the root of the repository. What OmniSim does not do is control time inside a run. There is no pause, no breakpoints and no record or replay, and a snapshot restores poses rather than resuming a checkpoint.

OmniSim is free and open-source, built on top of the Webots simulation engine by Cyberbotics Ltd., and distributed under the Apache License 2.0. It is maintained by OmniLink and is the simulation environment for the OmniLink agentic AI platform.
